scope: First-order selected-family/reachable-role risk-definition algebra only. Three direct no-risk consequences; isolated selected-getter/bridge-only execution SET and ADMIN populations with all ownership/grant flags false; execute-only owner-restoration population; selected/reachable nonempty closed population. No PostgreSQL privilege/SQL/cut/refinement/noninterference theorem.
